services.name: Sunset Tour
services.desc: For an extra-special experience, take a sunset helicopter ride over Clearwater Beach. This trip is a perfect romantic getaway for a date night or anniversary surprise! You can relax and enjoy the ride while soaking in views of the sun setting over the Gulf of Mexico and Pier 60. See Tampa Bay or the Gulf of Mexico in a whole new light. On this Sunset Helicopter tour, you’ll feel like you are in a photo. Soar high above the coast to watch the sunset from hundreds of feet above the white coastlines and blue waters of Clearwater Beach. services.name: Beach Helicopter Tour
services.desc: If you’re looking for one of the best helicopter tours in Florida, you’ve found it! A Clearwater Beach Helicopter Tour with Vertical Flight is the best way to see the crystal clear water and white sand of the Gulf of Mexico. Get the most beautiful, scenic beach views of Clearwater and the surrounding areas from above! See wildlife and spot dolphins while soaring over Florida coastlines and islands. Celebrate a special occasion or simply enjoy the view with this top Florida helicopter tour. Our Clearwater Beach Helicopter Tour flies over the Dunedin Causeway to Honeymoon Island. blurb: Guests experience helicopter rides over the Gulf of Mexico and Tampa Bay area, including scenic tours of Clearwater Beach, Tarpon Springs, Tampa Bay, and the Sunshine Skyway Bridge. The company offers family-friendly tours, wildlife watch tours, dolphin encounters, sunset tours, and customized aerial photography and survey services. Flights use Robinson R44 and R22 helicopters, accommodating up to three passengers per flight.
